---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a new check for attest
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What contract or data-quality gap are you hitting? Describe the ODCS field or
check attest does not currently handle. Link the relevant ODCS definition or
rule where you can.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like attest to do. If you are proposing a new rule, sketch the
check, the severity, and the failure it should report; if it changes the CSV
parser or the supported ODCS subset, describe the input involved.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
